description: After a booking has started, when the traveller says someone else is paying (a friend, a partner, a parent, their company); if you know before booking, pass payer to book_trip instead. Vuelo sends that person a secure link of their own, by text, email or both. Only when the traveller asks, with the name and the mobile or email they give you: never guess or reuse a number, and confirm it with the traveller first. The payer sees the trip, the price and who asked, never the traveller's own details, and pays in full from their own Vuelo account (no payment plan). The traveller's own link stops working, so the trip cannot be paid twice; the traveller still gets the booking confirmation. The link lasts 24 hours and the price is checked when they pay. Never pass the link on in the chat yourself.

email.description: Their email, to email the link.

mobile.description: Their mobile, to text the link.

name.description: The name of the person paying, as the traveller gave it.

name: send_to_payer
title: Send the pay link to someone else to pay
